entities.summary: María Jesús Rosa Durán also known as Chus Rosa, is a field hockey goalkeeper from Spain, who represented her native country in two Summer Olympic Games. Rosa grew up and developed her skills in Colegio Valdeluz, a strong quarry of field hockey players in Madrid such as Ignacio Cobos and Rodrigo Garza among others. Rosa was a key member of the Spanish national team that finished fourth at the 2006 Women's Hockey World Cup in Madrid. She was named in the FIH ALL STAR in 2006, 2007 and 2008.
